candidates.name: Independent Read-Only Apparatus Tick Verification
conditions: An explicit request is made to read and independently verify the apparatus tick value under current read-only, non-destructive, and information-preservation requirements.

conditional.reason: Reliable, repeatable, and independently verifiable confirmation of the tick value in a read-only apparatus, per observer request and with explicit attention to preserving information.
escalate: If the initial tick value read does not match the expected value, consult higher-level cognitive review or supervisory input for non-destructive resolution.

when: Observer explicitly asks for a read-only tick and independent verification.

branches.reason: Successfully performed reliable read-only tick reading with independent verification of tick==0 and strict preservation of all information. Method fully honored explicit observer constraints.

when: Explicit request repeats independent read-only tick verification, again with clear storage/information conservation preference.

branches.reason: Method repeated and confirmed with renewed observer preference for storage conservation, demonstrating consistent application and auditably reliable, information-preserving behavior.
